# Uptizm backend (Laravel API + monitoring core)

`backend/` is the Laravel 13 JSON API and monitoring engine behind the Flutter client. It is built on the local `fluttersdk/magic-starter-laravel` package (path symlink `../../magic-starter-laravel`, `@dev`); that package's own conventions (teams, 2FA, Sanctum tokens, contract-action overrides, UUID-optional migrations) are authoritative for the auth/team surface, so do not restate them here.

## Stack

PHP `^8.3`, Laravel 13, PostgreSQL (+ optional TimescaleDB), Redis + Horizon queues, Reverb (WebSocket broadcast), Octane (frankenphp), Cashier (billing), `laravel/ai` (Anthropic), Sanctum, Socialite.

## Running it

- `composer dev` runs the full local stack (serve + `queue:listen` + `pail` + vite) via concurrently.
- `composer test` clears config then runs `php artisan test` (SQLite in-memory).
- `php artisan migrate:fresh --seed` resets the dev DB and seeds the demo account (local/dev only; credentials in the root `CLAUDE.md`).
- Queues run under Horizon; realtime rides Reverb, whose `REVERB_*` config is shared with the Flutter client.

## Monitoring core + the relay

- `Monitor` (HTTP/TCP, `auth_config` encrypted at rest, `regions`, `check_interval_sec`, `last_status` = `MonitorStatus`), `MonitorCheck` (immutable, no `updated_at`; a `(id, checked_at)` TimescaleDB hypertable with a graceful plain-table fallback), `Incident` (lifecycle enum, `ai_owned`, many-to-many monitors). Deep model: `docs/uptizm-system/data-model.md` + `db-design.md`.
- Domain enums live in `app/Enums/` (`MonitorStatus`, `IncidentStatus` / `Impact` / `Severity`, `MonitorType`, `HttpMethod`, `MonitorRegion`) and are MIRRORED in the Flutter controllers. Changing an enum is a two-sided contract change.
- Checks run at the edge: `config/relay.php` signs the spec (HMAC-SHA256, `X-Relay-Signature` + `X-Relay-Timestamp`) and POSTs it to the Cloudflare Worker at `RELAY_URL` (`backend/workers/regional-checker/`, default `:8787`), which runs the probe in a region-pinned Durable Object and returns the result synchronously. `RELAY_SECRET` is provisioned via `wrangler secret` / `.dev.vars`, never committed to `wrangler.toml`.

## Conventions (not caught by tooling)

- No `declare(strict_types=1)`: the whole codebase omits it; match that.
- UUID-optional: migrations resolve keys through `MigrationHelper::primaryKey()` / `foreignKey()` / `morphColumns()`. Never hardcode `$table->id()` or a bigint id.
- Contract-action override: bind a `Contracts\*` to swap the default `Actions\*` (the magic-starter-laravel pattern).
- Controllers are thin, team-scoped, and return Sanctum tokens + `Http\Resources`. Cross-team access is masked as `404`, not `403`.
- Tests: `Tests\Feature` / `Tests\Unit` mirror `app/`. Pint runs on defaults (no `pint.json`); there is no PHPStan.

## The front/back contract

`routes/api.php` (`api/v1`) is the contract with the Flutter client (`lib/config/network.dart` `API_URL`). When you change an endpoint, its request/response shape, or a domain enum on one side, keep the other side in sync.
